# Overview

A reflective monologue on AI-era software and a nostalgia for tools you pay for once and keep forever. The visual identity is intentionally counter-cultural to the AI-landing-page aesthetic it critiques: no gradient text, no cyan, no particle fields. Instead it borrows from editorial print — Stripe Press covers, Vignelli's hairline-rule architecture, Kinfolk's slow vertical rhythm — to communicate craft, permanence, and considered restraint. The composition supports a talking-head plate (natural light, warm midtones) and never competes with the speaker's face: overlays sit in the negative space; the accent is warm champagne reserved for a single phrase per beat.

The canvas is a deep warm-cool black (`#0d0c10`, not `#000`) carrying gentle background-stop tints for full-bleed beats. The foreground is a creamy off-white (`#ece6d8`, not `#fff`) that matches the talking-head's warm midtones so cuts between overlay and plate don't feel like a temperature switch. The single accent — warm champagne `#c8a35a` — earns its appearance: it lands once per beat, on the load-bearing word, never decoratively.

# Colors

- **background `#0d0c10`** — primary canvas, all four beats. Warm-cool near-black. Never `#000`.
- **background-stop-1 `#0a090d`** — deeper tint for the PAYOFF full-bleed and gradient bottoms on background panels.
- **background-stop-2 `#070609`** — deepest tint, reserved for vignette edges if needed.
- **background-highlight-1 `#15131a`** — one-step lifted background used during the PIVOT stillness beat and for the talking-head plate's subtle vignette interior.
- **background-highlight-2 `#1d1b24`** — for any hairline panel inset behind a label.
- **foreground `#ece6d8`** — primary text color. Warm cream, matched to skin-tone midtones.
- **foreground-stop-1 `#d4cec1`** — body text on full-bleed background-stop-1 panels.
- **foreground-highlight-1 `#f7f2e6`** — the HOOK display word; reserved for the loudest typographic moment.
- **midtone `#8a8276`** — Inter labels (ALL CAPS tracked); secondary metadata.
- **midtone-stop-1 `#6e675d`** — label-on-light fallbacks; faint timestamps.
- **midtone-highlight-1 `#a39a8c`** — the PIVOT 'I thought —' label.
- **accent `#c8a35a`** — warm champagne, the single accent. Earns appearance per beat; never decoratively.
- **accent-stop-1 `#a88742`** — hairline column rule under the HOOK pulse and edge-to-edge rule on PAYOFF.
- **accent-stop-2 `#7c6230`** — deepest accent shadow stop; for an underline of a single word if needed.
- **accent-highlight-1 `#dab875`** — the PAYOFF phrase 'pay for once and use for life'.
- **rule `#2a2730`** — hairline rules between columns and under labels. 1px, never thicker.

All palette derivatives (background-stop-N, foreground-stop-N, accent-stop-N, highlight-N) are pre-baked so beat compositions never invent off-palette hexes for gradient stops, shadow tints, or hover states.

# Typography

Fraunces (variable serif) for headline and display; Inter for body and labels. Never two sans-serifs.

- **headline (Fraunces 300, 5.5rem, tracking -0.015em, line-height 1.05)** — the load-bearing serif of the piece. Used on PROBLEM and PAYOFF. Light weight is deliberate: a heavy serif would feel keynote-corporate; a light Fraunces feels considered and editorial.
- **display (Fraunces 400, 8rem)** — single-word HOOK only ('Age.'). Earns its size by being alone in frame for ~1.2s.
- **body (Inter 300, 1.125rem, line-height 1.65)** — Inter Light for any sentence-length supporting text. Never bold body.
- **label (Inter 500, 0.75rem, tracking +0.18em, ALL CAPS)** — overline labels (e.g., 'I thought —', 'on craft'). Tracking is mandatory.

# Layout

- Talking-head plate occupies the full frame as the base layer at all times; overlays compose on top of it, never replacing it.
- Two safe-zones: left column (0–42% of frame width) and bottom band (lower 18%). The speaker's face lives in the right 58% / upper 82%; do not overlay there.
- Hairline column rules (`rule #2a2730`, 1px) separate overlay columns from the talking-head plate.
- All overlay text is left-aligned. No centered text except on the final PAYOFF, which may center on the full-bleed beat.
- Padding scale: `xs 8`, `sm 16`, `md 32`, `lg 64`, `xl 120`. The xl value (120px) is the standard left-gutter for headlines.
- Corners: `0px` everywhere except occasional `2px` softening on the smallest label chips. No rounded cards.

# Elevation

Flat. Depth comes from hairline rules and background-stop tints, never from `box-shadow`. The single allowed shadow is the subtle vignette baked into the background-highlight-1 interior of the talking-head plate during the PIVOT beat — and even that is a radial-gradient tint, not a CSS shadow. No glassmorphism, no blur, no glow.

# Components

- **Overline label**: Inter 500, 0.75rem, color `midtone`, tracking +0.18em, ALL CAPS. Sits 8px above its associated headline with no rule between them; the tracking does the separating.
